links.outcome: Concordance of LLM therapy recommendations with MDT decisions, compared across two reasoning models
links.effect: OpenAI o1 achieved higher concordance with MDT decisions than DeepSeek-R1 (76.9% vs. 53.8%, p < 0.001); aligned with either MDT or guidelines 80.0% vs. 63.1%, p = 0.005.
links.quote: OpenAI o1 achieved higher concordance with MDT decisions than DeepSeek-R1 (76.9% vs. 53.8%, p < 0.001) and more recommendations aligned with either MDT or guidelines (80.0% vs. 63.1%, p = 0.005).

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of clinical recommendations against human experts
Multi-expert prompting strategy with guidelines provided as context

screen.reason: The study evaluates the concordance of LLM-generated therapy recommendations for GIST cases against multidisciplinary tumor board decisions and guidelines without testing specific deployment safeguards.
